output_dir.description: The directory where decoded files will be written.

autorename.description: Appends a dot and unique sequence number to filenames if they already exist.

autoclear.description: Removes input files that were successfully decoded.

ignore_mode.description: Ignores original file permissions, resetting to 0666.

fast_mode.description: Fast mode for file scanning, assuming single part per file.

ignore_replies.description: Ignores reply messages (subjects starting with Re:).

use_plaintext.description: Uses plaintext messages, offering unnamed text parts.

desperate_mode.description: Desperate mode to attempt decoding incomplete files.

bracket_policy.description: Prefers numbers in brackets [] over parentheses () for part numbers.

minus_smartness.description: Turns off automatic part number detection from the subject line.

extensions_to_decode.description: List of file extensions to include for decoding (e.g., ['gif', 'jpg']).
